name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router patterns.

Modes: Server=secrets/data/heavy computation; Client=interactivity/hooks/browser APIs; Static=build time; Dynamic=request/personalized; Streaming=progressive slow/large pages.

Files: layout.tsx, page.tsx, loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx, route.ts, template.tsx, default.tsx, opengraph-image.tsx.

Patterns: `app/layout.tsx`: `Inter` from `next/font/google`, `Providers`, metadata, `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>`, `<body className={inter.className}>`. `app/page.tsx`: Server Component; async `fetch('https://api.example.com/products', { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })`. `app/products/page.tsx`: `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>`, `Suspense`, `ProductList`, `ProductListSkeleton`, `FilterSidebar`; `sort?: 'price' | 'name' | 'date'`, `category`, `page`. `components/products/ProductList.tsx`: colocated async fetch, `{ next: { tags: ['products'] } }`, `throw new Error('Failed to fetch products')` when `!res.ok`; `ProductCard`, `Pagination`. `components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx`: `useState`, `useTransition`, `addToCart` from `@/
